cwe_content.cwe: CWE-22,Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')

candidate.Reason: Directly uses zip entry name without path traversal validation when creating output file, allowing attacker to write files outside the intended destination directory
Creates directories based on zip entry names without path traversal validation, allowing directory creation outside target directory
Creates parent directories for extracted files without validating if they are within the intended destination, enabling path traversal attacks
Writes file content to potentially malicious path constructed from zip entry name without traversal validation
